description: This file defines a feature for retrieving profile details within a C# ASP.NET Core application, including a query class, validator, and handler for processing profile detail requests.

classes.name: Details.Query
classes.description: Defines the request for profile details, encapsulating the username parameter.

classes.name: Details.QueryValidator
classes.description: Validates the Query to ensure the username is not empty.

classes.name: Details.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the profile detail request by reading the profile using the provided profile reader service.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the profile detail query, returning the profile envelope asynchronously.
